title: A hand-typed purchase order line is received under its own number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test.
  • Create an open purchase order for this test, purchase order 1, from any vendor, with one line where part A's number was typed by hand and added as typed, 1 ordered and none received.
  • Use a new part number that no part and no Part Library entry has yet, and that does not contain part A's number.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with the new number.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click Purchase Orders in the left menu.
  6. Open purchase order 1.
  7. Click Receive.
  8. Type an invoice number in the invoice number field.
  9. Type 10.00 as the cost.
  10. Type 1 as the received quantity.
  11. Click Receive on the Receive screen.
  12. Click Vendor Invoices in the left menu.
  13. Open the vendor invoice you just received.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Part Number shows the new number.

Step 4:

  • The rename is saved, the window closes and part A's row shows the new number.

Step 5:

  • The Purchase Orders list opens.

Step 6:

  • Purchase order 1's hand-typed line still reads the old number.

Step 7:

  • The Receive screen opens with the line under the old number.

Step 8:

  • The invoice number shows what you typed.

Step 9:

  • The cost shows 10.00.

Step 10:

  • The received quantity shows 1.

Step 11:

  • The line is received.

Step 12:

  • The Vendor Invoices list opens.

Step 13:

  • The vendor invoice's line reads the old number: a hand-typed line is received under its own number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R19c: “For a line linked to the renamed part, accepting a delivery uses the part's current number, even when the Receive screen was opened before the rename. No Part Library entry is created for the old number. A hand-typed line (S13-R19a) is received under its own number.”
  • S13-R19a: “A line that only shares the old number, typed in by hand with no link to this part, keeps its number.”
